feat(spark): parse dotted column identifiers in column definitions [CLAUDE] (#8570)

* feat(spark): parse dotted column identifiers in column definitions [CLAUDE]

Spark and Databricks column definitions can now name a column with a dotted
path, e.g. ADD COLUMNS (a.element.b INT), which adds a field to an existing
struct. The path parses into an exp.Dot as the ColumnDef name.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Update sqlglot/parsers/spark.py
